description: Desktop-only capability set for the main SecuraCV Lab window. Intentionally EMPTY: the self-update flow (manifest check, native confirm dialog, relaunch) is driven entirely from Rust (self_update.rs), and so are the menu bar companion's tray and notifications (companion.rs). The webview is granted none of plugin:updater, plugin:dialog, plugin:process, plugin:notification, core:tray or core:menu — the tray and the menu are ungranted to it, not ungateable: a script in the Lab's origin could not remove or relabel the fleet tray because no capability lets it. The Lab frontend uses core.invoke, event and opener only (see default.json). Granting anything more here only widened what an injected script could do. Kept as a file so the desktop/iOS platform split stays visible.
